def: To put numbers together to find how many in all.
To find how many of something you have.
Things that are the same type, so you can group them together.
example: 3 apples + 2 apples = 5 apples, but apples and oranges are not the same kind.

def: A set of things that go together.
example: 2 boxes + 4 boxes makes one group of 6 boxes.
